+"""align_calendar spine: one calendar of the dates every ticker has a close for, no fill."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from mdata.calendar import align_calendar
+from mdata.types import Prices, RawRow
+
+
+def test_sample_keeps_dates_every_ticker_has(contract_sample):
+    rows = [RawRow(**row) for row in contract_sample("mdata.RawRow")["rows"]]
+    prices = align_calendar(rows)
+    assert prices == Prices(
+        dates=("2024-01-02", "2024-01-03", "2024-01-05"),
+        tickers=("AAA", "BBB"),
+        closes={"AAA": (100.0, 102.0, 103.0), "BBB": (50.0, 50.5, 51.0)},
+    )
+
+
+def test_unsorted_rows_give_sorted_dates_and_tickers():
+    rows = [
+        RawRow("2024-01-03", "ZZZ", 2.0),
+        RawRow("2024-01-02", "AAA", 10.0),
+        RawRow("2024-01-03", "AAA", 11.0),
+        RawRow("2024-01-02", "ZZZ", 1.0),
+    ]
+    prices = align_calendar(rows)
+    assert prices.dates == ("2024-01-02", "2024-01-03")
+    assert prices.tickers == ("AAA", "ZZZ")
+    assert prices.closes == {"AAA": (10.0, 11.0), "ZZZ": (1.0, 2.0)}
+
+
+def test_date_one_ticker_lacks_is_dropped():
+    rows = [
+        RawRow("2024-01-02", "AAA", 10.0),
+        RawRow("2024-01-02", "BBB", 5.0),
+        RawRow("2024-01-03", "AAA", 11.0),
+    ]
+    prices = align_calendar(rows)
+    assert prices.dates == ("2024-01-02",)
+    assert prices.closes == {"AAA": (10.0,), "BBB": (5.0,)}
+
+
+def test_no_rows_give_empty_prices():
+    assert align_calendar([]) == Prices(dates=(), tickers=(), closes={})

+"""Unit tests for mdata.io.read_csv (PL-01 step 1, DATA-01)."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+
+from mdata.io import read_csv
+from mdata.types import RawRow
+
+
+def _write(tmp_path: Path, text: str) -> Path:
+    path = tmp_path / "prices.csv"
+    path.write_text(text)
+    return path
+
+
+def test_rows_come_back_in_file_order(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    path = _write(
+        tmp_path,
+        "date,ticker,close\n2024-01-03,BBB,50.5\n2024-01-02,AAA,100.0\n2024-01-02,BBB,50\n",
+    )
+    assert read_csv(path) == [
+        RawRow(date="2024-01-03", ticker="BBB", close=50.5),
+        RawRow(date="2024-01-02", ticker="AAA", close=100.0),
+        RawRow(date="2024-01-02", ticker="BBB", close=50.0),
+    ]
+
+
+def test_blank_close_is_none_not_zero(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    path = _write(tmp_path, "date,ticker,close\n2024-01-02,AAA,\n2024-01-03,AAA,  \n")
+    assert [row.close for row in read_csv(path)] == [None, None]
+
+
+def test_short_row_has_no_close(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    path = _write(tmp_path, "date,ticker,close\n2024-01-02,AAA\n")
+    assert read_csv(path) == [RawRow(date="2024-01-02", ticker="AAA", close=None)]
+
+
+def test_accepts_a_str_path_and_column_order(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    path = _write(tmp_path, "ticker,close,date\nAAA,1.5,2024-02-29\n")
+    assert read_csv(str(path)) == [RawRow(date="2024-02-29", ticker="AAA", close=1.5)]
+
+
+def test_header_only_gives_no_rows(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    assert read_csv(_write(tmp_path, "date,ticker,close\n")) == []
+
+
+def test_missing_column_raises(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    path = _write(tmp_path, "date,ticker\n2024-01-02,AAA\n")
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=r"missing column\(s\) close$"):
+        read_csv(path)
+
+
+def test_empty_file_raises_missing_columns(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="missing column"):
+        read_csv(_write(tmp_path, ""))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("bad", ["2024/01/02", "20240102", "2024-1-2", "2023-02-29", ""])
+def test_malformed_date_raises(tmp_path: Path, bad: str) -> None:
+    path = _write(tmp_path, f"date,ticker,close\n{bad},AAA,1.0\n")
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="malformed date"):
+        read_csv(path)

+"""Unit tests for the validate_rows spine: keep rows with a close, sorted."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from mdata.types import RawRow
+from mdata.validate import validate_rows
+
+SAMPLE = Path(__file__).parents[2] / "contracts" / "mdata.RawRow" / "sample.json"
+
+
+def _sample_rows() -> list[RawRow]:
+    data = json.loads(SAMPLE.read_text())
+    return [RawRow(**row) for row in data["rows"]]
+
+
+def test_sample_drops_the_blank_close() -> None:
+    out = validate_rows(_sample_rows())
+    assert len(out) == 7
+    assert RawRow("2024-01-04", "BBB", None) not in out
+    assert all(row.close is not None for row in out)
+
+
+def test_output_sorted_by_date_then_ticker() -> None:
+    rows = [
+        RawRow("2024-01-03", "BBB", 2.0),
+        RawRow("2024-01-02", "BBB", 1.0),
+        RawRow("2024-01-03", "AAA", 3.0),
+        RawRow("2024-01-02", "AAA", 4.0),
+    ]
+    out = validate_rows(rows)
+    assert [(r.date, r.ticker) for r in out] == [
+        ("2024-01-02", "AAA"),
+        ("2024-01-02", "BBB"),
+        ("2024-01-03", "AAA"),
+        ("2024-01-03", "BBB"),
+    ]
+
+
+def test_empty_input_gives_empty_list() -> None:
+    assert validate_rows([]) == []
